g1-implement.title: G1 scoreboard harness: implement
g1-implement.imperative: Build the COMMON SCOREBOARD: a reusable, unit-tested pure-metric core in src/physics/layer2/scoreboard.py (knee-vs-raw-sensor on a braking zone; non-throttle ringing-vs-raw-ceiling) plus a thin orchestrator (refactor scripts/validate_refine_505.py to call the core) that runs the fixed case set Bahrain T1 (heavy stop), Monaco (short-straight ringing), Spa (control) on 2023 Q VER and emits a metrics table. Record the CURRENT-smoother baseline to a JSON under reports/physics/ (gitignored) AND verify it reproduces the #505 numbers (.agent-work/505_validation_findings.md) within tolerance. The metric core must accept ANY estimation variant via an injected callable (variant -> a_long profile + regime masks) so every spike is measured identically. Fill templates/IMPLEMENTER_HANDOFF.template.md with task, scope, close criteria, constraints, test mode (test-led), the map anchors below, and ABSOLUTE paths into the main checkout for the FastF1 cache + telemetry (worktree-untracked-data). Dispatch a constellation-implementer subagent. Integrate the returned IMPLEMENTER_RESULT.

g2-implement.title: G2 portfolio exploration: implement (5 parallel worktree spikes)
g2-implement.imperative: Dispatch FIVE constellation-implementer spikes, EACH IN ITS OWN WORKTREE (Agent isolation=worktree), each prototyping ONE evolutionary mechanism against the G1 scoreboard and returning scoreboard deltas + a short findings writeup (prototype code stays in the worktree — NOT landed in main). The five: M4 regime-gated process noise; M1 model-shape onset anchor inside kind=3; M7 model-aware raw-speed denoise -> kind=3 anchor; M3 decoupled 1D physics-constrained longitudinal filter on the speed channel; M8 semi-parametric onset mean function. Each handoff carries: the G1 scoreboard seam, the mechanism's one-paragraph thesis, the two-cycle-anchor invariants it must respect or consciously extend, ABSOLUTE main-checkout paths for FastF1 cache + telemetry, and the close criterion (scoreboard numbers on Bahrain/Monaco/Spa + honest reproducibility + a soundness note incl. failure modes). Record each dispatch in crew-runs.json via run_crew.py pure registry functions; run recover_crews.py before each. Consolidate all five into ONE comparison artifact (.agent-work/496-physics-aware-estimator/SPIKE_COMPARISON.md) and return it as the IMPLEMENTER_RESULT.

Measure combinations on the G1 scoreboard; land the best. Requirements: honest covariance (first-class, not point estimates); L1-L4 truth evidence for any new/changed physics model; py -m src.utils.simplification_limits clean on touched paths; full test coverage incl. the failure cases. Fill the implementer handoff with absolute data paths + the inherited anchors. Dispatch a constellation-implementer subagent (Opus tier — heaviest gate). Integrate IMPLEMENTER_RESULT.

triage_candidates.statement: scripts/validate_refine_505.py: pre-existing simplification_limits violations (main CC~44, fn_lines~213; _run_one_circuit fn_lines~139) + unused imports (driver_num/driver_streams/stint_span). #504-style cleanup; not a G1 blocker.
scripts/validate_refine_505.py loads each session twice when run_scoreboard runs; a run_case(session=...) seam would remove the redundancy (G2+ refactor).

M8 semi-parametric onset mean: conceptually sound but under-determined on 4Hz GPS kinematic samples (degenerate sigmoid fits). Revival needs >=10Hz car telemetry as the onset-fit data path - a separate future scope, not this evolutionary step.

#518: terrain/z-map pool absent from the G1 CaseInputs scoreboard seam (single fastest lap), so variant_synthesis runs FLAT on the scoreboard; the terrain-aware F_vehicle path is only exercised by the proof driver. Add a terrain handle to the seam if #518 wants the scoreboard to grade F_vehicle.

#518: the a_long acceptance metric is structurally blind to the PE term (round-trip invariance, proven). To reward the total-energy/terrain work, #518 needs a gravity-corrected F_vehicle braking-frontier metric (fit BrakingView on F_vehicle), not the a_long knee/ringing scoreboard.
